h: פָּרָשַׁת כִּי תָבוֹא, ג׳ Ki Savo, 3
The First Fruits Reveal Israel’s Chosen Root of Holiness

p: "And you shall come to the Kohen
who will be in those days" (Devarim 26:3);
what is the point of this regarding a Kohen?
And it appears that one must examine
"I declare today to Hashem your God"
why should he say to the Kohen "your God"
And what need is there for a declaration
that he came to the Land?
And in the Zohar on Parshas Vayera
and in many places it says
so what wisdom is there in this?
that the matter of the mitzvah of Bikkurim
is like the mitzvah of sanctifying the firstborn,
that everything is from Hashem Yisbarach:
"The earth and its fullness are Hashem's" (Tehillim 24:1),
from among the whole speaking species.
to sanctify him as holy of holies,
for he is the head of Yisrael.
"He caused to be forgotten," etc., "festival and Shabbos,
and He spurned," etc., "king and Kohen":
that these two correspond to those,
as is known from Sefer Yetzirah,
corresponding to it is the king,
"You shall surely set over yourself," etc.;
and he is in place of the heart in the body,
as is written in Sefer Yetzirah;
and so the festivals in the year,
and they are the wellsprings of life for the whole year,
And Shabbos — Hashem Yisbarach sanctified it
and gave this holiness to Yisrael,
"for I am Hashem Who sanctifies you."
And this is through the revelation
of the light of Keser Elyon,
the dew and the brow of the Holy Ancient One,
for there, in the tefillin of the Master of the world,
for they cleave in their root
"Bereishis — for the sake of Yisrael," etc.
and it is the head and beginning
"for Yaakov God has chosen for Himself" (Tehillim 135:4)
and in relation to them all of Yisrael
the Kohen is the head of all Yisrael,
in that Hashem Yisbarach chose him and sanctified him,
כְּמוֹ שֶׁכָּתוּב עַל פָּסוּק (תְּהִלִּים סה, ה)
as is written on the pasuk (Tehillim 65:5; Bamidbar Rabbah 3:2):
Aharon, whom He chose and brought near;
"The lips of the Kohen shall guard knowledge," etc.;
